{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = sales_df.isnull().sum()

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = sales_df.duplicated().sum()

# Check the distribution of the 'converted' column
conversion_counts = sales_df['converted'].value_counts()

# Check the 'customer_age' column for outliers or implausible values
age_stats = sales_df['customer_age'].describe()

# Output all of these checks
missing_values, duplicates, conversion_counts, age_stats"}
